text:
Priya (People Ops): Drafting a compact "Week One Card" for managers — single page they can paste into calendar invites. Quick review? Link to drive: https://redwood.ok/weekone-card :wave:

Priya (People Ops): Card outline:
- Pre-start: submit IT form, confirm buddy, send intro email.
- Day1 AM: org + product 30m, manager 1:1 30m (expectations + comms), team intro 30m.
- Day1 PM: accounts + access, quick security brief.
- Day2: architecture walkthrough + product sync.
- Day3: local dev + starter PR assigned.
- Day4: cross-team intros + draft 30/60/90.
- Day5: ship/pair on small change + feedback.

Nate (Eng Manager): Nice. Two tiny asks: add a "first commit" rubric and a 1.5h deploy-shadow slot on Day5.

Rin (DevEx): I'll add starter-issues link and auto-label "onboard-starter" so reviewers know. Also paste this PR template into the card:
```
Summary: one sentence
Test plan: how to run locally
Checklist: [ ] tests [ ] lint [ ] 1 reviewer
```

Samir (IT): Managers please file IT ticket ASAP: https://redwood.ok/it-newhire. Requests before 10:00 PST on start day get same-day hardware. Include manager approval for VPN/KMS.

Priya (People Ops): Adding buddy guidance: peer buddy for 4 weeks, 15m stand daily week1 then twice weekly. Also a one-slide "who to ask" (payroll, benefits, oncall, infra).

Ava (new-hire): Thanks! Quick q: what's an acceptable Day3 PR size?

Nate (Eng Manager): Hi Ava  keep it small: docs fix, single test, or small bug (1-3 files). We'll pair if you want.

WelcomeBot: Week1 calendar invites created 10:00-12:00 local. Manager, buddy, and new hire added.

Priya (People Ops): I'll publish the card and a fillable 30/60/90 template by EOD. Managers  please confirm buddy and IT ticket 48h before start. :sparkles:
